The '''Sheva system''' was in the [[Freeworlds Territory]] of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], between [[Allandor system/Legends|Allandor]] and [[Pelagon]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in this [[Star system/Legends|system]] were highly industrialized and developed.
